title: Bano ka Tha Nouha Ali Asghar ki Lahed Par
body:
Bano ka tha nouha Ali Asghar ki lahad par
Kya sogaye Asghar , kis tarha madine ko main jaoon mere dilbar kya sogaye Asghar
Baba bhi hume chod ke maqtal ko sidhare wapas nahin aaye, aur tum bhi chale chod ke maa ko sue kousar kya sogaye Asghar
Haye khoon main tar chand sa ruqsar hua hain kya zulm huwa hai, wo nanni si gardan pe chala teere sitamgar kya sogaye Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Qatil tera kya sahibe aulaad nahin tha ye bhi nahin socha, marega tumhe teeer toh marjayegi maadar kya sogaye Asghar
Aye laal teri saal gira bhi na rachayi mannat na badhayi
Ye nanne shaloke kise pehnaoo main dilbar kya sogaye Asghar
Amma ko gaye chood ke tum kiske sahare bolo mere pyaare , yeh bhi nahin socha ke na jee payegi maadar kya sogaye Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab doon kise lori kise jhoole main jhulaoon kisko main sulaoon, yaad ata hai aagosh main ana wo humak kar kya sogaye Asghar
Ek pal ko mera saat jo tum paate nahin the ghabrate the darke, araam se ab leyt gaye qabar ke andar kya sogaye Asghar
Sughra tumhein puchegi toh main usko kahoon kya batlaoo khudara , kistarha wo jee payegi bolo Ali Asghar kya sogaye Asghar
Jis waqt chala karwaan ye karbo bala se the maa ke yeh naale , chillati thi aye moosavi roro ke ye maadar kya sogaye Asghar..
